data.description:
## Goal

Add a new remote fallback provider, `MunitoAI` (`deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-flash`), as the final tier of the `plan`, `code` and `author` model chains, so requests fall through to it when every existing remote tier (opencode-go-3 / -2 / -go, deepseek-flash) is unavailable or in cooldown.

Operator-provided parameters and documented assumptions:
- Provider brand: `MunitoAI`
- Endpoint: `https://api.munito.ai/inference` (the proxy appends `/v1/chat/completions`; no trailing `/v1`)
- Upstream model id: `deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-flash`
- API key env var: `MUNITOAI_API_KEY`, resolved at startup from `~/.pi/agent/auth.json` key `munitoai` (operator has already added the key).
- Placement: appended as the LAST tier, after `deepseek-flash`, in all three chains.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `models.plan.providers`, `models.author.providers` and `models.code.providers` in `proxy/config.yaml` each end with a `munitoai` remote entry: `provider: MunitoAI`, `endpoint: https://api.munito.ai/inference`, `api_key_env: MUNITOAI_API_KEY`, `model: deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-flash`.
- [ ] The same three chains in `proxy/config-fast.yaml` include the identical `munitoai` entry (the fast overlay replaces provider lists wholesale, and fast is the active mode).
- [ ] No change is required in `proxy/config-cheap.yaml` (it inherits `models` from the base config) — verified, not assumed.
- [ ] `proxy/scripts/start-proxy.sh` resolves `MUNITOAI_API_KEY` from `~/.pi/agent/auth.json` without emitting a missing-key error.
- [ ] A request served by the tier returns `X-Resolved-Model: MunitoAI/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-flash`.
- [ ] Config loads and validates via `load_config`, and the full test suite passes — including the mode-grandfathering remote-provider-count tests (base and fast are updated symmetrically so the per-mode counts stay balanced).

## Notes

- `forward_session_headers: false` is added as a precaution against gateways that reject `session_id`; confirm against the live endpoint and drop it if unnecessary.
- `discovered-from:` LP-context: requested by operator during interactive session. Worklog id to be assigned.
